stage_definitions.catalogued: Authoritative source system and relevant datasets are identified in the machine-readable catalog.
stage_definitions.acquisition: Repository contains executable code that retrieves source-native artifacts with provenance metadata.
stage_definitions.normalized: Source-native records are parsed into stable OpenEconomy concepts without silently changing their measurement definition.
stage_definitions.curated: At least one reviewed, reproducible fact set from the source is checked into data/curated or produced deterministically.
stage_definitions.graph: At least one fact from the source is published in the default reported-data graph.

sources.name: Bureau of Economic Analysis
sources.notes: Public Integrated Macroeconomic Accounts and open-data catalog download without credentials; BEA API key enables NIPA, input-output, industry, international, regional and MNE API pulls.

sources.name: Federal Reserve Financial Accounts / FWTW
sources.notes: Z.1 bulk files and Issuer-to-Holder / From-Whom-to-Whom matrix are wired. FWTW edges must retain inferred/estimated evidence status.

sources.name: Bureau of Labor Statistics QCEW
sources.notes: 2025 national covered wages and employment are normalized, reconciled by ownership and live on the reported graph.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR
sources.notes: Ticker map plus complete Company Facts and submissions bulk archives are wired; company/entity normalization is next.

sources.name: Census CBP / Annual Business Survey
sources.notes: 2023 CBP and ABS API pulls are wired. Census key is required for the configured queries.

sources.name: Federal Election Commission
sources.notes: Official cycle aggregates are curated/live. Full 2025-2026 candidate, committee, contributor, transfer, candidate-payment, operating-expenditure, independent-expenditure, electioneering, communication-cost and bundled-lobbyist files are wired but transaction-level normalization is not complete.

sources.name: USAspending
sources.notes: Federal award spending-over-time acquisition is implemented; recipient/award entity resolution is not yet normalized.

sources.name: Treasury Fiscal Data
sources.notes: Monthly Treasury Statement Table 1 acquisition is implemented; fiscal-account normalization is not yet complete.

sources.name: Senate Lobbying Disclosure Act
sources.notes: Source identified; exact production API/download contract still needs implementation and verification.

sources.name: FDIC BankFind Suite
sources.notes: Institutions, financials, locations, history and Summary of Deposits are in scope; adapter not yet implemented.

sources.name: Energy Information Administration
sources.notes: Open Data API and no-key bulk facility are in scope; adapter not yet implemented.

sources.name: IRS Statistics of Income
sources.notes: SOI is a family of products rather than one dataset; household, corporate, nonprofit and migration products require explicit subcatalog/adapters.

sources.name: Census Commodity Flow Survey
sources.notes: 2022 CFS APIs and public-use microdata are identified; adapter not yet implemented.
